description: This file is a shell script that implements tests for the resilience of Git pack objects against corruption. It includes functions to create test files, manipulate Git packs, inject specific corruptions, and verify correct handling of corrupted objects in various scenarios.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Creates sample files with random and fixed content for testing.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Creates a new Git pack with test objects, verifies them.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates the pack, potentially corrupting it for testing resilience.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Injects corruption into a specific object within the pack file at a given offset.
